snippet.title: Promised Harvest - Pre-Register Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello Harvesters! 
The trailer for the pre-registration of Promised Harvest in Play Store is now open!
Go and make your pre-register, and as a reward for those who make it, in the launch game will receive a: Free "Gamer Eli" skin!



• Game link:

Play Store: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.promised_harvest&pcampaignid=web_share


• Game Social Midia:


• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/promised_harvest_game?igsh=b280bDllcTVhOWMx

• X: https://x.com/joao_pedroso11

• Discord: https://discord.gg/GRXpnz68JC



God bless you all!
- DEV João Pedroso 

#indiegame #promisedharvest #mobilegame
